newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind shares up ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind shares up ahead of results.

text.p: Shares of Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd, an investment arm of the Shanghai municipal government, rose ahead of the release of the company's year-end earnings report due later on Thursday.
The company's shares rose HK$1.40 or 4.23 percent to HK$34.50 in late morning on volume of 3.12 million shares.
Brokers said expectations that the company's earnings would beat its own forecast aided buying, especially in view of recent demand for China plays led by hopes of asset injections.

Analysts forecast Shanghai Industrial would post a profit of HK$340 million to HK$364 milion for the year ended in 1996, compared with the company's own forecast of not less than HK$310 million stated in its listing prospectus last year.
